expectations.name: name_only_fork_artifact_privileged_use_reachable
expectations.intent: Check whether name_only permits an attacker-controlled fork artifact named package to be privilegedly used.
required_events: ArtifactStored(artifact_id, producing_run, 'package', body, fork_repo, fork_branch, commit)
PrivilegedUse(name_only, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, fork_repo, fork_branch, commit, body)

expectations.name: run_bound_fork_artifact_privileged_use_reachable
expectations.intent: Check whether run_bound permits an attacker-controlled fork artifact to be privilegedly used when the triggering run itself is a fork run.
required_events: RunComplete(trigger_run, fork_repo, fork_branch, commit, build_workflow, success)
PrivilegedUse(run_bound, trigger_run, artifact_id, trigger_run, fork_repo, fork_branch, commit, body)

expectations.name: name_only_all_privileged_uses_are_trusted_origin
expectations.intent: Safety question: whether every name_only privileged use came from protected_repo and protected_branch.
required_events: PrivilegedUse(name_only, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, repo, branch, commit, body)

expectations.name: run_bound_all_privileged_uses_are_trusted_origin
expectations.intent: Safety question: whether every run_bound privileged use came from protected_repo and protected_branch.
required_events: PrivilegedUse(run_bound, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, repo, branch, commit, body)

expectations.name: trusted_origin_all_privileged_uses_are_trusted_origin
expectations.intent: Safety question: whether every trusted_origin privileged use came from protected_repo and protected_branch.
required_events: PrivilegedUse(trusted_origin, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, repo, branch, commit, body)

expectations.name: name_only_selected_artifact_belongs_to_triggering_run
expectations.intent: Run-provenance safety question: whether name_only always selects an artifact whose producing run is the triggering run.
required_events: ArtifactSelected(name_only, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, name, body, repo, branch, commit)

expectations.name: run_bound_selected_artifact_belongs_to_triggering_run
expectations.intent: Run-provenance safety question: whether run_bound always selects an artifact whose producing run is the triggering run.
required_events: ArtifactSelected(run_bound, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, name, body, repo, branch, commit)

expectations.name: trusted_origin_selected_artifact_belongs_to_triggering_run
expectations.intent: Run-provenance safety question: whether trusted_origin always selects an artifact whose producing run is the triggering run.
required_events: ArtifactSelected(trusted_origin, trigger_run, artifact_id, producing_run, name, body, repo, branch, commit)

expectations.name: legitimate_protected_branch_deployment_executable_all_configs
expectations.intent: Establish that protected-branch build-to-deployment executions are possible for name_only, run_bound, and trusted_origin configurations.
required_events: PrivilegedUse(name_only, trigger_run1, artifact_id1, producing_run1, protected_repo, protected_branch, commit1, body1)
PrivilegedUse(run_bound, trigger_run2, artifact_id2, trigger_run2, protected_repo, protected_branch, commit2, body2)
PrivilegedUse(trusted_origin, trigger_run3, artifact_id3, trigger_run3, protected_repo, protected_branch, commit3, body3)
